modelsWrap.lede: Set what each model you serve charges per million tokens, and add time-of-use windows (a cheaper night rate, a free daily window). Changes publish immediately and survive the node reconnecting - they only ever set future prices, never what was already billed.

mdCatNote: Each card shows the category your station registered (a guess is marked ~). Change it here with Edit category (it then wins over the node's own), or from the node with roger share --category, the TUI SHARE tab (g), or the local console's Category button.
mdCeil: Price ceiling: $50 in / $100 out per 1M tokens. It applies to every band, public or private - a private band hides a station from the market, it is not a price bypass.
